text: For the new 2021 cohort (cohortA) I'm going with GRCh38 (GRCh38_full_analysis_set), not GRCh37. This cohort is brand new so there is no legacy comparability constraint, and GRCh38 is what the annotation caches expect. Locking the reference build now.
sounds right. what base quality filter are we using for the caller?
min-base-quality-score 20 for the first pass. 20 is the GATK default and a sensible starting point. We can revisit if it drops too many hets.
ok. keeping standard-min-confidence-threshold-for-calling at the GATK default too then.
